newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia plans 158-km highway to link hill resorts.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia plans 158-km highway to link hill resorts.

text.p: Malaysia is planning to build a 158-kilometre highway to link three major resort towns in the country's central highlands, Works Minister S. Samy Vellu was quoted as saying by the national Bernama news agency.

The government was doing an environmental impact assessment (EIA) for the 2.5 billion ringgit ($1.0 billion) highway to connect Genting Highlands, Cameron Highlands and Fraser's Hill, he said at Taiping in Perak state.
The construction of the highway was expected to begin later this year, once the government cleared the EIA report, Samy Vellu said.
